DO queued ascending unheld+undated, recent descending max12 and live hot.used versus used_final verified. Full read/display freshness R7, with named readCoverage seam.
Actual listGrants inclusive filters/order/row receipt object and ABO grouping read. PG4 falsifies credential attribution and PG1 can mask duplicate application; no full R8 query UX review claimed.
Outbox writes D1 then distinct per-grant R2 NDJSON before row deletion; shape matches. PG1 duplicate-key silence and D4 lost wakeup qualify durability. Rebuild/lock attestation R9.

Paid event order term_ended→term_activated→grant_applied established; receipt uses last sequence. Current per-event snapshots reflect intermediate states rather than required final post-grant state: D1 pure final-plan recipe explicitly covers final-state snapshots with each event sequence. R7 validates consumers/page boundaries.

Actual canonical JWS signer and ledger_seq=grant_applied clinic_seq; DO stores original receipt and copies it verbatim. ABO signature-only acceptance and complimentary context mismatch are A2. D1/D4 qualify receipt-to-state durability.
Published capability array copied into entrypoint snapshot; DO stores JSON and term/admission consumer reads capability/cost/concurrency. No reinterpretation at activation; full admission R5.

Nonempty approvals enforced by shared validator and paid receiver. Paid empty list returns approvals_required; complimentary generic invalid-envelope path currently returns unit_not_allowed. The rejection prevents value; bounded error-code deviation retained for R8 contract consistency, not an additional major/moderate finding.
Reference-only transcription instruction; amended current rule used. No test/workflow correctness analysis.
Complete calendar and grant/boundary callers verified: UTC month clamp/leap behavior, exact day units, staging replacement lengths. Harness instructions excluded.
Reference-only test-clock/harness instruction; no excluded test/harness source analyzed. Production override isolation remains R9.

Greatest policy version passed to DO, per-grant arithmetic and strict-lower/inclusive-upper 90-day window source traced; D5 installation-local history violates per-org ceiling. R2-P2 owns second-assertion binding; full policy administration R8.
Actual queued/recent field mapping matches amended lists and hot/used_final selection; API-to-desktop freshness stays R7. No new grant mutation rule.

ABO constructs one paid grant operation with base envelope sans approvals, empty actor, paid_at, deterministic nonce/version; shared acceptance and machine signature receiver traced; no WebAuthn requirement applied to paid path.

Live getCoverage snapshot/fallback and notice producers read; checkout outcome maps success to Active. Upstream R3 has payment DTO lineage coverage; complete payment-history/desktop business semantics remain R7. No inferred full R7 review.

Paid unverifiable signature parks+AL07 without outcome; complimentary receipt path lacks matching/verification, A2. Missing object paid response currently retries; selected identity/receipt fix routes unverifiable/missing success to parked recovery.

Shared validator accepts paid operation-object shape without credential/assertion and complimentary string-shaped evidence. Actual HP signer remains distinct; PG4 owns false credential lineage. Exact paid producer shape verified.

Identifier helper, bounded ABO package loop and DO import loop use index0..k-1 and one deterministic request/import per element. Full transfer recovery R6; PG1 global original-grant replay boundary is established here.

Bounded checkReceiptMismatch reads every successful nontransfer outcome, flags absent listGrants row, canonical-compares full receipt including signature. DO→D1/R2 copies traced; complete reconciliation scheduling/rebuild remains R9.
